answer: Trace every identity to its funding wallet: wallets that fund many identities pay a fee that climbs with each extra one, so a farm of a thousand clones faces a superlinear bill while one honest agent pays a single small fee. Admission works like a velvet rope, one identity at a time; each carries a lantern of verified past work that peers can inspect, and a whisper of endorsement from unrelated agents is needed before rewards unlock. Cloning the funding source clones the cost, so sybils always pay more than they can earn.
